journeys.label: Understand
journeys.title: Understand before automating
journeys.description: Ground an agentic-system decision in public evidence, principles, and reproducible observations before turning it into automation.
journeys.verification: You can name the evidence or reproduced observation that supports the decision, including the limits it does not resolve.

journeys.label: Plan work
journeys.title: Move from guidance to governed work
journeys.description: Install focused guidance and express engineering intent, evidence gates, reviews, and execution state as a governed artifact.
journeys.verification: You leave with installed guidance or a typed plan and can identify the gate that permits the next execution step.

journeys.label: Specify
journeys.title: Make system intent executable
journeys.description: Turn system intent into validated specifications, deterministic intermediate artifacts, generated contracts, and conformance evidence.
journeys.verification: The specification validates and produces a deterministic artifact or conformance result that another tool can inspect.

journeys.label: Build agents
journeys.title: Build an observable agent loop
journeys.description: Run and compare provider-neutral model and tool loops with explicit approvals, budgets, effects, isolation, and retained session evidence.
journeys.verification: A run completes with its session evidence retained and its effects, approvals, and budget decisions visible for inspection.

journeys.label: Operate services
journeys.title: Carry governed contracts into operation
journeys.description: Adopt authenticated, auditable service boundaries without collapsing distinct command, identity, event, secret, workflow, or connector responsibilities.
journeys.verification: A bounded command or workflow completes and its authenticated state change or resulting evidence can be inspected.
